title: Ulduar
wikitext:

With [[Uldum]] and [[Uldaman]], there is a third base of the [[Titan]]s named '''Ulduar'''. A fourth location, [[Maraudon]], is the location of [[Terramok]], an ancient titan vault. A fifth location, a storage facility, is located under [[Bael Modan]]. Ulduar is located at [[The Storm Peaks]] of [[Northrend]]. It is controlled by [[storm giant]]s, and their minions the [[crystal golem]]s.
